description: This file implements traversal logic for an abstract syntax tree (AST) used in shader compilation, including methods for visiting, traversing, and modifying nodes such as symbols, functions, blocks, and expressions within the 'sh' namespace.

classes.name: TIntermNode
classes.description: Base class for AST nodes with traversal capability.

classes.name: TIntermSymbol
classes.description: Represents symbol nodes in the AST.

classes.name: TIntermBlock
classes.description: Represents block nodes containing sequences of statements.

classes.name: TIntermCase
classes.description: Represents case nodes within switch statements.

classes.name: TIntermTraverser
classes.description: Class for traversing and modifying AST nodes with customizable visit behavior.

classes.name: TLValueTrackingTraverser
classes.description: Specialized traverser that tracks whether expressions are l-values.

methods.name: traverse
methods.description: Generic method to traverse a node and its children, with pre, in, and post visit options.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Method called on nodes during traversal to perform specific actions.

methods.name: traverseBinary
methods.description: Traverse a binary node, handling specific binary operations.

methods.name: traverseFunctionDefinition
methods.description: Traverse a function definition node, managing scope.

methods.name: traverseBlock
methods.description: Traverse a block node, managing statement sequence and scope.

methods.name: updateTree
methods.description: Apply queued insertions and replacements to the AST, validating the tree.

methods.name: clearReplacementQueue
methods.description: Clear queued node replacements and insertions.

methods.name: queueReplacement
methods.description: Queue a node replacement for later application.

methods.name: queueReplacementWithParent
methods.description: Queue a node replacement with explicit parent node.

methods.name: setInFunctionCallOutParameter
methods.description: Set whether the current expression is an out parameter in a function call.

methods.name: isInFunctionCallOutParameter
methods.description: Check if currently in a function call out parameter context.
